description: Mark MANY tasks done in one call (bulk). Provide EXACTLY ONE of `ids` (explicit corpus ids) or `query` (a query expression whose matches are completed). Best-effort per-item: one bad id is reported failed and the rest proceed — the response is {outcomes:[{id,status,reason}], applied, failed, skipped}. Recurrence advances and onCompletion fires per task (same pipeline as complete_task). Per-item was_dependency_blocked:true flags an item completed while a dependsOn target was still open (informational, never refused; checked against the batch's initial scan, so a blocker completed earlier in the same batch still reads as open). Per-item warnings carry what complete_task's warnings would: a dependsOn target naming no task, and references an onCompletion delete left dangling. with_children:true also completes each task's inline subtree. dry_run:true previews every outcome without writing.

allow_partial.description:
Downgrade an unsupported `query` filter condition to a warning
(partial match) instead of a hard error. Ignored for `ids`.

dry_run.description:
When true, PREVIEW every completion without writing: the full
per-id outcome list is returned, nothing is mutated.

ids.description:
Explicit corpus ids to complete. Provide EXACTLY ONE of `ids` or
`query`.

now_time.description: Pin the wall-clock "now" (`HH:MM`) used by timed-overdue in `query`.

query.description:
A query expression whose matches are completed. Provide EXACTLY
ONE of `ids` or `query`.

space.description:
Archive with this saved space's (id or name, as `list_spaces`
reports it) archive folder or file rather than the one the task's
own spaces select. Applies to every onCompletion archive this
call fires. An unknown space is refused.

today.description:
Pin "today" (`YYYY-MM-DD`) for today-relative filters in `query`
(`due:today`, `overdue:`) so the match set resolves identically
between a dry-run count and the commit. Default = the host's day.

with_children.description:
When true, also complete each task's inline subtree (parent + every
incomplete descendant). Parent recurrence + onCompletion still fire.

name: bulk_complete_tasks
